title: security: rbac v2 enforce KMS region residency + audit logging enhancements
author: Ava Chen
description: Context: Customer audits and recent compliance reviews (SUP-2045) require stricter enforcement of KMS region residency and richer audit events for RBAC v2-managed resources. Previously we only surfaced KMS key ids in audit logs; residence constraints were advisory. This PR makes enforcement opt-in via a cluster-level feature flag (rbac_v2_enforce_kms_residency) and flips enforcement for customers who have signed the residency SLA. Summary of changes: - Policy evaluator: add kms_region constraint checks during evaluation; if enforcement is enabled, requests that reference KMS keys outside allowed regions are rejected with a 403 + structured error. - Audit pipeline: include kms_key_region, kms_key_id and residency_policy_id in audit events for create/update/delete of resources that reference KMS. - DB: new migrations to add kms_residency_policies table (policy id, allowed_regions, owner_team, status) and a backfill script to map existing KMS bindings to policy placeholders. - Admin API: endpoints to create/read/update residency policies and to toggle enforcement per-tenant. - Tests: unit tests for policy evaluator, integration tests exercising audit event generation and end-to-end rejection paths. - Docs: update RBAC v2 policy docs and migration notes. Motivation: make data residency explicit and enforceable for regulated customers while preserving opt-in behavior for existing customers. Checklist: - [x] Design reviewed (ENG-3421, SEC-114) - [x] DB migration and backfill tested locally - [x] Unit + integration tests added - [x] Feature flagged for gradual rollout - [x] Docs updated (redwood-docs) Rollout plan: deploy on staging with feature flag off, exercise backfill and audit event sampling, then enable enforcement for pilot tenants with direct SRE/Customer Success oversight. Monitoring/observability: added metrics kms_residency.enforcement.rejects and audit.events.kms.enriched. Performance: policy evaluator short-circuits on policies that don't include KMS constraints; microbenchmarks show ~1.7% median latency impact on RBAC checks when enforcement is enabled (within SLO). Migration notes: backfill is idempotent and runs as a background job; it will create residency policy placeholders; manual mapping required for ambiguous KMS bindings. Support: SUP-2045 contains customer migration assistance steps.

audit: include kms_key_region and residency_policy_id in audit events
api: admin endpoints for kms residency policy management
tests: add unit + integration tests for enforcement and audit enrichment
docs: update rbac v2 policy and migration docs
ci: stabilize flaky audit pipeline test
files_changed: src/auth/rbac/policy_evaluator.py - added kms_region enforcement checks and short-circuit logic (approx 75 LOC)

README.md - note about enforcement opt-in and rollout
review_comments:
Jordan Patel: Requested changes
can we avoid an extra DB join during policy evaluation? Suggest caching residency_policy_id on the resource binding row or denormalize allowed_regions for fast rejection paths.

Ava Chen: Reply
agreed. Implemented a memory cache with TTL in the evaluator and added a migration to optionally store residency_policy_id on kms_bindings. Benchmarks included in the PR description show negligible memory impact.

Priya Singh: Question
backfill safety: how do we avoid mismatches for customers with multiple keys per resource?

Ava Chen: Reply
backfill creates placeholder policies and marks them 'needs-review' for Customer Success. We added a manual reconciliation UI and documented steps in SUP-2045.

Luca Moretti: Approval
reviewed code paths, audit enrichment looks fine. Left minor nits about log verbosity which were addressed.
CI (flaky-test): The audit pipeline unit test failed on first run (timeout). Re-ran the pipeline; all checks passed on second run.
release_notes:
- Enforceable KMS region residency for RBAC v2-managed resources (feature-flagged)
- Audit events enriched with kms_key_region, kms_key_id, residency_policy_id
- New admin API and DB schema for managing residency policies
- Idempotent backfill job to initialize residency mappings for existing customers
test_plan: Run migrations on staging, execute backfill with a snapshot of customer KMS bindings, run integration tests that simulate cross-region KMS references, enable feature flag for pilot tenant and verify rejects and enriched audit events. Monitor kms_residency.enforcement.rejects metric during rollout.
changelog_excerpt: Security: Add opt-in enforcement for KMS region residency and richer audit logging for RBAC v2; new admin controls and migration tools provided.
